comparison.objective: Apply an opaque primer coat with a loaded brush while managing excess primer and drips; unlike tuning and locking an industrial motion damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires brush pickup, dipping, rim wiping, compliant brushing, re-dipping, and controlled deposition. It does not exercise recessed hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, lock torque, or iterative mechanical response adjustment. Generic tool grasping does not establish overlap.
comparison.success_condition: Scores coated-patch coverage, coat opacity, spill limits, prohibited bench contact, brush placement, and 1 s hold. It does not test stopping energy, stroke, rebound, hard-stop contact, overload, setting drift, or repeatable cycles. Missing/ambiguous details: no brush-force or damage thresholds, and the body says “no drips” while full-score specs allow at most one bench drop.
comparison.reason: Controlled liquid coating with a compliant brush tests deposition and spill management, not mechanical commissioning or retention of a dynamically validated damper setting.
